info.name: Dana Kasir - Dana Summary API
info.description:
API testing untuk Dana Summary (Daily Cash Flow Summary). Menampilkan ringkasan harian income dan expenses.

🔐 AUTHENTICATION:
• Menggunakan Clerk session token dari browser cookies
• Role: Kasir (read), Owner (read)

📋 ENDPOINT:
• GET /api/kasir/dana-summary - Get daily summary with income & expenses

📊 RESPONSE DATA:
• summary: totalIncome, totalExpense, netBalance, date
• income: List of rental transactions (IncomeItem[])
• expenses: List of expenses (PengeluaranKasir[])

⚡ FEATURES:
• WITA timezone support (Asia/Makassar)
• Date filtering (default: today)
• Aggregated calculations

📚 Documentation: .kiro/specs/dana-kasir-management/
